description: Filter + rank live DeFi lending/staking pool APYs across every protocol/chain (DefiLlama, ~15k pools). POST `{ chain?, project?, asset?, stablecoinOnly?, minTvlUsd?, includeOutliers?, limit? }`; returns pools sorted by APY (percent units, apyBase/apyReward split), TVL, stablecoin + ilRisk flags, and the DefiLlama poolId. Exploit-y outlier pools excluded by default. Unpaid: free while the caller's IP has free-trial calls left that day (a small daily allowance shared across the trial stalls, no wallet); otherwise returns 402. Flat-priced per request. (PAID x402 service — USDC on Base; the MCP server needs a funded wallet to settle.) Price: $0.005 USD (fixed).

asset.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the pool symbol

name: defi_yields
